paper_metadata.title: Effect of high-entropy alloy thin film interlayer on microstructure and mechanical properties of vacuum diffusion welded TA15/304SS joints

evidence.quote: CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy thin films (HEAFs) were fabricated on TA15 (near- α Ti alloy) and 304 stainless steel (SS) substrates using magnetron sputtering.
TA15, a near- α titanium alloy, combines the dual advantages of α -titanium alloys and ( α + β ) titanium alloys, demonstrating excellent thermal stability and weldability
304 stainless steel (304SS), a widely used Cr-Ni based stainless steel, exhibits lower cost and excellent corrosion resistance
the TA15/304SS joints welded with the CoCrFeNiMn HAEF interlayers, that were deposited at 25 ◦ C, 200 ◦ C, 400 ◦ C, and 600 ◦ C, were named as samples 1, 2, 3, and 4, respectively.
